currentRoundInspection.scope: Useful pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only; no bespoke survey or redistributed photography.

pictures.observed: Aerial: long raised red-tiled nave/lower aisles,raised east roof ribs,triple eastern apses,four small roof turrets. Ghirlandina square tiered shaft has increasingly large grouped openings,upper octagonal belfry/stone spire and thin cornice crowns. Exclude adjacent domed church and town.

West front: large recessed spoke rose,stepped nave/aisle gables,two small upper turrets,three-arch gallery bays,selected tall pilasters and two-tiered projecting central porch. Pale limestone/marble with sparse warm stone variation. Exact figures and reliefs excluded.

South entrance detail: pink-toned deep concentric round portal with columns,carved supports and dark closed door under a glazed lunette. Selected architectural bands/columns represented; exact lions/reliefs/capitals excluded.
